props.headline: Careers at Sun State
props.subhead: One team behind Sun State International Trucks and Sun State Trailers — over 200 employees across five West Central Florida locations, hiring in sales, service, parts and aftermarket.

image.alt: Sun State technicians at work — photograph to be supplied

values.heading: We're not like everyone else.
values.body:
We believe our people are the driving force that keeps our customers — and the trucking industry — moving forward. That's why we foster a culture of respect, appreciation, and opportunity, recognizing every employee's contribution to our shared success.

We're always looking for motivated, hardworking professionals who are passionate about helping fleets stay on the road and businesses keep moving. Whether in sales, service, or parts, teamwork drives everything we do — and it's what allows us to deliver for our customers, every time.

If you're ready to bring your skills to an industry where reliability matters most, we'd love to hear from you. Explore our open positions and apply today.

image.alt: The Sun State team at work — photograph to be supplied

values.heading: A family, not just a company.
values.body: As a family-owned and operated business, we've created an environment where every team member plays a crucial role in our success. In our workplace, we believe a team works best when united with a common goal. It's this unique culture that is the driving force behind our remarkable success of over 30 years.

items.title: Community
items.body: At Sun State, we're more than a business; we're a family. Within our tight-knit community, every individual is not merely an employee but a valued member.

items.title: Growth
items.body: Investing in the growth and development of our people is a cornerstone of our company culture. We encourage our team to make the change they want to see.

items.title: Transparency
items.body: We operate on the principle of "open book" transparency, allowing our employees a clear view of how their contributions directly impact our success.

items.title: Dependability
items.body: We hold our employees responsible for upholding our mission and values, and at the core of our values is an unwavering commitment to customer care and satisfaction.

values.heading: Where you could fit in.
values.body: Whether you're new to the industry or looking to take the next step, we offer opportunities to learn, lead, and thrive. Both Sun State International Trucks and Sun State Trailers hire through one portal.

items.title: Service
items.body: Diesel and trailer technicians, mobile service, aftermarket modifications and DOT inspections. Apprentice Technician Program for people new to the trade.

items.title: Parts
items.body: Counter and territory parts sales, warehouse and delivery roles supporting over $14M in OEM, Diamond Advantage and all-makes inventory.

items.title: Sales & Rental
items.body: New and used truck sales, Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailer sales, fleet solutions, rental operations and finance.

items.title: Corporate & Support
items.body: Accounting, human resources, marketing, IT and administration across the Tampa headquarters and store locations.

items.title: What benefits does Sun State offer?
items.body: Market-based and incentive pay, medical, dental, vision and prescription coverage, an EAP, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, life insurance, AD&D, disability, PTO, supplemental health, identity protection and an employee discount program.

items.title: Do you hire technicians with no experience?
items.body: Yes. Our Apprentice Technician Program and tuition reimbursement let people new to the industry train into certified technician roles.

items.title: Where can I work?
items.body: Five West Central Florida locations: Tampa, Sarasota, Davenport, Brooksville and the Tampa Aftermarket Business.

items.title: How do I apply?
items.body: Browse and apply online through our careers portal. Trucks and trailers roles are posted in the same place.

values.heading: Ready to begin your career journey with Sun State?
values.body: Explore our open positions and apply today.
